Name: DT Fleet Deployer
Description: Least-privilege role for `dt_appservice_fleet.py deploy`/`uninstall`. Adds exactly the writes the tool performs: set app settings, set the startup command (site config), and restart. Does NOT grant create/delete of sites, scaling, networking, slots, publish credentials, or any other management action. Assign to the delegated user who runs deployments — no Service Principal or admin account required. Prefer scoping AssignableScopes/assignment to the target resource group(s) rather than the whole subscription.
